sources.title: Stadt Wien — Baumkataster

sources.processing: No geographic filtering. Source records retained, including geometry problems reported separately; Geneva observer identities omitted. No proximity deduplication.

sources.coverage: Downloaded planting-site export; service count disagrees (105439 vs105476 rows). Completeness against live service is unverified.
sources.verificationNotes: The full GeoJSON export contains 105,476 unique planting-site IDs. A second fresh export contains the same ID set. The WFS hits response reports 105,439. These counts are not reconciled. Completeness against the live service is unverified. Records can describe empty planting sites or non-living trees. Only Pianta viva maps to existing status; other source statuses remain notes.

sources.title: Madrid
sources.coverage: Complete selected official publisher export; not a census of all trees.
sources.processing: ETRS89 / UTM zone30N transformed to EPSG:4326. All publisher rows retained.
sources.verificationNotes: The July 2026 export has 799,110 rows. ETRS89 / UTM zone 30N coordinates are transformed to WGS84. The official field guide defines ALTURA_TOTAL in metres and PERIMETRO in centimetres, measured at 1.3 m. ASSETNUM is retained as the tag; datastore row IDs are scoped to the release. The inventory excludes forest masses, palms, nurseries and trees managed by several other municipal bodies.

sources.title: Paris
sources.attribution: Direction des Espaces Verts et de l'Environnement - Ville de Paris
sources.coverage: Complete selected official publisher export; not a census of all trees.
sources.verificationNotes: The municipal inventory excludes woodland and private trees. Ten source rows repeat idbase values. A release-row suffix preserves each conflict; no records are silently removed. Height is metres and circumference is centimetres. The ODbL licence remains attached to this dataset.

sources.title: Florence
sources.coverage: Complete selected official publisher export; not a census of all trees.
sources.verificationNotes: The complete public-tree export contains 82,269 rows. Twelve rows have repeated publisher IDs. A release-row suffix preserves each conflicting record and a quality note identifies the conflict. CIRCONF_CM is circumference in centimetres. Source positions have documented accuracy of about 5 m.

sources.title: Milan
sources.coverage: Complete official downloadable archive. Resource name says March 2025; archive member says March 2024. Observation vintage is unresolved.
sources.verificationNotes: The archive has 247,779 records. Its resource label says March 2025, but the archive member is named March 2024. Observation vintage is unresolved. h_m is an explicit height in metres. Trunk and crown diameter values remain notes; diameter is not circumference. data_ini is not assumed to be a planting date.

sources.coverage: All published tagged public trees; this excludes untagged trees.
Published municipal and selected valuable private trees; woodland trees are usually absent.
Published managed freestanding trees and valuable trees; not every tree in woodland.
All published municipal inventory records; field collection is incomplete. Removed and planned replacement information is retained.

sources.attribution: Senatsverwaltung für Mobilität, Verkehr, Klimaschutz und Umwelt Berlin
sources.coverage: All published street and park WFS tree records. The geographic service can omit inventory records without positions; private and separately managed trees are outside this source.
All records in the published Bäume layer. This is not a census of all physical trees.

sources.attribution: Administration de la nature et des forêts — Luxembourg
sources.coverage: Selected remarkable trees across Luxembourg; this is not a national tree census.

sources.attribution: Nantes Métropole et Ville de Nantes — Direction Nature et Jardins
sources.coverage: Published tree locations across Nantes Métropole and city-managed properties. Includes empty planting sites and source records awaiting qualification.
Published tree locations; incomplete inventory and source updates paused during migration. Circumferences can be group averages.
All published municipal tree rows. Inventory accuracy and update dates vary.
Current 2026 tree service: park/street trees and trees in wooded planting areas. Layer-qualified IDs preserve every source row.
All current published municipal individual trees; fields remain incomplete after system migration. Native GeoJSON coordinates are ETRS89 UTM32 despite the requested WGS84 output.

sources.licence: Gratis Open Data Licentie Vlaanderen v1.0
sources.coverage: Published individually managed trees in public space. Woodland is represented separately as areas. The council approved release of Groeninventaris_BOOM as open data in 2015.
Published general, woodland and depot tree layers. Special-tree and genus-rendering layers are excluded as overlapping views. Woodland and depot layers were empty at acquisition.

sources.attribution: Direction des Monuments et des Sites (DMS), Région de Bruxelles-Capitale (MRBC)
sources.coverage: Factual extract from the official remarkable-tree map. Selected heritage trees, not a complete city census. Custom attribution terms apply; photographs and narrative descriptions are excluded.
Complete official CSV snapshot dated 1 August 2024, published February 2025. Newer changes in the public map are not implied.

blocked.reason: The official map exposes DYNDATA/SCENERY/FeatureServer/0. A sample query returned Latin names and WGS84 points. Service copyright and portal item licenseInfo are empty. The national open-data catalogue returned no matching city tree cadastre. Bulk redistribution permission remains unverified.

The official CKAN record links an October 2026 Gdanska_Zielen_WFS service and field dictionaries. Its licence fields are empty. Service requests failed or timed out during this review. Both a working full export and applicable reuse terms must be verified.

The official ZZM MapServer layer 3 returned 104012 records in a count query. It exposes Latin/common names, arbotag and circumference fields. Service copyright is empty. General portal permissions for other resources do not establish permission for this tree layer. Redistribution terms remain unverified.

The official 3D model and public configuration expose inventoried vegetation and separate remote-sensing layers. The map offers area-based exports. This review did not verify a complete repeatable individual-tree export with applicable redistribution terms. LiDAR trees must not be presented as species inventories.

The official page distinguishes Baza Zieleni field inventory from canopy mapping. The linked map failed to connect during this review. No complete licensed individual-tree export was verified. A WMS map alone does not meet the search and details contract.
